new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+name: Cinder Shift complete art scenes
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths: ['games/cinder-shift/**', 'art/world-production/**', 'scripts/world-production-art.mjs', 'scripts/check-world-production-art.mjs', 'tests/art-production.spec.ts', 'tests/world-enemy-model.spec.ts', 'playwright.art-production.config.ts', '.github/workflows/cinder-art-production.yml']
+  workflow_dispatch:
+concurrency:
+  group: cinder-art-production-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  scenes:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        group: [base, small, adriatic, six]
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: 22, cache: npm}
+      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - run: npm run art:check
+      - run: npm run build
+      - run: node scripts/build-rework-harness.mjs
+      - name: Render the actual installed art and gather room evidence
+        run: npx playwright test --config=playwright.art-production.config.ts --grep '${{ matrix.group }}' --reporter=line --output=test-results/production-art
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: cinder-art-${{ matrix.group }}
+          path: |
+            test-results/production-art/
+            dist/cinder-shift/build-manifest.json

+# Cinder Shift production art
+
+Original generated masters, transparent-object crop maps, reproducible exports and editable SVG materials/hand layers. The untouched PNG masters and prompts are in `source/`. `manifest.json` records every source hash, exported frame, visible bounds and source rectangle.
+
+Run `npm run art:production`, then `npm run art:check`. Export uses hard alpha, nearest-neighbour sampling and a shared 256-colour palette. Background textures are 320×140, displayed at 640×280 with nearest-neighbour filtering and loaded by sector. Original master pixels remain available for re-export.
+
+The atlas contains 176 frames: 60 sector props, 60 mechanism states, 30 world-enemy states, 15 base-enemy states, 5 Regulator aperture states and 6 carry/action overlays. The runtime also uses 16 sector backgrounds and 10 material kits. Actual object positions come from gameplay geometry. The renderer never advances gameplay state.
+
+`previews/contact-sheet.png` shows the actual exported frames. It is an asset preview, not a screenshot of the game. `playwright.art-production.config.ts` and the art-production workflow collect actual Phaser evidence in every room. Physical mobile/device validation and complete production acceptance remain open; see the alpha.15 report.
+
+Original exports are retained as `reference-atlas.png` and `reference-manifest.json`. Runtime PNG/JSON, material SVG exports and the contact sheet are rebuilt automatically by npm check, build, dev, test and art checks. Derived runtime assets and previews are ignored by Git; source masters and SVGs remain versioned. The change to automatic export was prepared after the local environment disconnected and must pass CI on its own commit.

+{
+  "baseBackgrounds": "Production pixel-art BACKGROUND SHEET for the FIRST campaign of CINDER SHIFT 64 industrial side-view platform game. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS x THREE ROWS of panoramic rectangular scenes. No text, labels, UI, hero, enemies, floating platforms, foreground gameplay objects. Detailed 16-bit pixel art with clear square clusters, dark ink outlines, cold navy steel #142331/#20384a/#405c70, brass #dfa568, cream highlights #efd6a4, teal #65a7a5; coherent civilian orbital industrial complex, worn practical machinery, depth and atmospheric light. Each panel has three readable depth planes and a DARK QUIET LOWER THIRD, clean uninterrupted space for engine-added colliders. EXACT order: row1 left AIRLOCK: pressure bulkheads, dock windows, huge ventilation fans, pressure gauges, curved metal ducts, cyan cool lighting; row1 right CARGO: rail gantry, stacked shipping containers, freight elevator structure, crane hoists, orange work lights and distant loading dock; row2 left FOUNDRY: large furnaces, casting vats, suspended hydraulic assemblies and cooling pipes, warm rust-orange glow; row2 right ARCHIVE: tall server cabinets and tape spools, shelves, analog consoles, optical conduits, muted violet-cyan lighting, distinct library-of-machines feel; row3 left REACTOR: huge shielded circular reactor in distance, cooling turbines, power bus conduits, restrained mint light, very detailed but quiet lower combat lane; row3 right REGULATOR CHAMBER: colossal maintenance hall with overhead gantries, cable harnesses, deep steel buttresses, round reactor window behind boss staging zone on RIGHT, empty foreground, amber warning fixture architecture, no boss drawn. Make all panels distinct, finished commercial game environment illustration. Panel borders exactly aligned in even grid, edge-to-edge imagery, no gutters.",
+  "baseEnemies": "CINDER SHIFT 64 industrial pixel-art GAME SPRITES. Transparent background with alpha zero outside each object. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACT GRID 5 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, 20 isolated sprites centered in cells, generous empty margins. No text, labels, grid lines, floor shadows or backgrounds. Hard pixel clusters at 80 logical pixels per sprite, nearest-neighbor feel, detailed commercial-quality metal shading. Palette navy #142331, blue steel #405c70, cool edge #78949f, cream #efd6a4, yellow hazard brass #dfa568, turquoise #65a7a5 and vulnerable core #91d2b8. Facing LEFT, side-view platform game, NOT isometric. Five states per row: idle / warning / attack / exposed recovery / destroyed. Row1 MAINTENANCE WALKER: two short articulated legs, compact riveted steel body, cream shoulder shell, horizontal plasma tool gun, amber three-slot sensor, different purposeful silhouettes in each state. Row2 SECURITY DRONE: compact flying armored steel sphere with two short ducted thrusters, horizontal camera slit, copper coils, left-facing emitter, warning antenna extends, firing muzzle, vent flaps open to show mint capacitor core, broken wreck. Row3 RAM CHARGER: low heavy wheeled maintenance bulldozer with a shield-plough front, steel and yellow caution strips, idle upright shield, warning crouched charge preparation, attack shield-forward charge, recovery shield lifted and mint engine open, wreck. Row4 REGULATOR CHEST APERTURE INSERT ONLY: a small horizontal octagonal armored opening, dark blue steel rim with four brass corner bolts, designed to be composited into an existing giant robot's chest. Five equal-footprint states: closed ribbed metal shutters; closed shutters with amber warning vents; locked armored shutters with copper charge lines; fully parted shutters exposing a detailed glowing mint cylindrical reactor with copper coils and cables; dark shattered powerless reactor. Aperture insert must be a finished mechanical component, not a simple rectangle or UI icon. Row4 all exactly same horizontal frame shape and size, substantial inset depth and metal bevels, narrow side wings for opened shutters. Every sprite isolated and consistent within row, no people."
+}

+name: Cinder Shift complete art scenes
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths: ['games/cinder-shift/**', 'art/world-production/**', 'scripts/world-production-art.mjs', 'scripts/check-world-production-art.mjs', 'tests/art-production.spec.ts', 'tests/world-enemy-model.spec.ts', 'playwright.art-production.config.ts', '.github/workflows/cinder-art-production.yml']
+  workflow_dispatch:
+concurrency:
+  group: cinder-art-production-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  scenes:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        group: [base, small, adriatic, six]
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: 22, cache: npm}
+      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - run: npm run art:check
+      - run: npm run build
+      - run: node scripts/build-rework-harness.mjs
+      - name: Render the actual installed art and gather room evidence
+        run: npx playwright test --config=playwright.art-production.config.ts --grep '${{ matrix.group }}' --reporter=line --output=test-results/production-art
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: cinder-art-${{ matrix.group }}
+          path: |
+            test-results/production-art/
+            dist/cinder-shift/build-manifest.json

+# Cinder Shift production art
+
+Original generated masters, transparent-object crop maps, reproducible exports and editable SVG materials/hand layers. The untouched PNG masters and prompts are in `source/`. `manifest.json` records every source hash, exported frame, visible bounds and source rectangle.
+
+Run `npm run art:production`, then `npm run art:check`. Export uses hard alpha, nearest-neighbour sampling and a shared 256-colour palette. Background textures are 320×140, displayed at 640×280 with nearest-neighbour filtering and loaded by sector. Original master pixels remain available for re-export.
+
+The atlas contains 176 frames: 60 sector props, 60 mechanism states, 30 world-enemy states, 15 base-enemy states, 5 Regulator aperture states and 6 carry/action overlays. The runtime also uses 16 sector backgrounds and 10 material kits. Actual object positions come from gameplay geometry. The renderer never advances gameplay state.
+
+`previews/contact-sheet.png` shows the actual exported frames. It is an asset preview, not a screenshot of the game. `playwright.art-production.config.ts` and the art-production workflow collect actual Phaser evidence in every room. Physical mobile/device validation and complete production acceptance remain open; see the alpha.15 report.
+
+Original exports are retained as `reference-atlas.png` and `reference-manifest.json`. Runtime PNG/JSON, material SVG exports and the contact sheet are rebuilt automatically by npm check, build, dev, test and art checks. Derived runtime assets and previews are ignored by Git; source masters and SVGs remain versioned. The change to automatic export was prepared after the local environment disconnected and must pass CI on its own commit.

@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+{
+  "baseBackgrounds": "Production pixel-art BACKGROUND SHEET for the FIRST campaign of CINDER SHIFT 64 industrial side-view platform game. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS x THREE ROWS of panoramic rectangular scenes. No text, labels, UI, hero, enemies, floating platforms, foreground gameplay objects. Detailed 16-bit pixel art with clear square clusters, dark ink outlines, cold navy steel #142331/#20384a/#405c70, brass #dfa568, cream highlights #efd6a4, teal #65a7a5; coherent civilian orbital industrial complex, worn practical machinery, depth and atmospheric light. Each panel has three readable depth planes and a DARK QUIET LOWER THIRD, clean uninterrupted space for engine-added colliders. EXACT order: row1 left AIRLOCK: pressure bulkheads, dock windows, huge ventilation fans, pressure gauges, curved metal ducts, cyan cool lighting; row1 right CARGO: rail gantry, stacked shipping containers, freight elevator structure, crane hoists, orange work lights and distant loading dock; row2 left FOUNDRY: large furnaces, casting vats, suspended hydraulic assemblies and cooling pipes, warm rust-orange glow; row2 right ARCHIVE: tall server cabinets and tape spools, shelves, analog consoles, optical conduits, muted violet-cyan lighting, distinct library-of-machines feel; row3 left REACTOR: huge shielded circular reactor in distance, cooling turbines, power bus conduits, restrained mint light, very detailed but quiet lower combat lane; row3 right REGULATOR CHAMBER: colossal maintenance hall with overhead gantries, cable harnesses, deep steel buttresses, round reactor window behind boss staging zone on RIGHT, empty foreground, amber warning fixture architecture, no boss drawn. Make all panels distinct, finished commercial game environment illustration. Panel borders exactly aligned in even grid, edge-to-edge imagery, no gutters.",
+  "baseEnemies": "CINDER SHIFT 64 industrial pixel-art GAME SPRITES. Transparent background with alpha zero outside each object. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACT GRID 5 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, 20 isolated sprites centered in cells, generous empty margins. No text, labels, grid lines, floor shadows or backgrounds. Hard pixel clusters at 80 logical pixels per sprite, nearest-neighbor feel, detailed commercial-quality metal shading. Palette navy #142331, blue steel #405c70, cool edge #78949f, cream #efd6a4, yellow hazard brass #dfa568, turquoise #65a7a5 and vulnerable core #91d2b8. Facing LEFT, side-view platform game, NOT isometric. Five states per row: idle / warning / attack / exposed recovery / destroyed. Row1 MAINTENANCE WALKER: two short articulated legs, compact riveted steel body, cream shoulder shell, horizontal plasma tool gun, amber three-slot sensor, different purposeful silhouettes in each state. Row2 SECURITY DRONE: compact flying armored steel sphere with two short ducted thrusters, horizontal camera slit, copper coils, left-facing emitter, warning antenna extends, firing muzzle, vent flaps open to show mint capacitor core, broken wreck. Row3 RAM CHARGER: low heavy wheeled maintenance bulldozer with a shield-plough front, steel and yellow caution strips, idle upright shield, warning crouched charge preparation, attack shield-forward charge, recovery shield lifted and mint engine open, wreck. Row4 REGULATOR CHEST APERTURE INSERT ONLY: a small horizontal octagonal armored opening, dark blue steel rim with four brass corner bolts, designed to be composited into an existing giant robot's chest. Five equal-footprint states: closed ribbed metal shutters; closed shutters with amber warning vents; locked armored shutters with copper charge lines; fully parted shutters exposing a detailed glowing mint cylindrical reactor with copper coils and cables; dark shattered powerless reactor. Aperture insert must be a finished mechanical component, not a simple rectangle or UI icon. Row4 all exactly same horizontal frame shape and size, substantial inset depth and metal bevels, narrow side wings for opened shutters. Every sprite isolated and consistent within row, no people."
+}

+name: Cinder Shift complete art scenes
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths: ['games/cinder-shift/**', 'art/world-production/**', 'scripts/world-production-art.mjs', 'scripts/check-world-production-art.mjs', 'tests/art-production.spec.ts', 'tests/world-enemy-model.spec.ts', 'playwright.art-production.config.ts', '.github/workflows/cinder-art-production.yml']
+  workflow_dispatch:
+concurrency:
+  group: cinder-art-production-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+jobs:
+  scenes:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        group: [base, small, adriatic, six]
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: 22, cache: npm}
+      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - run: npm run art:check
+      - run: npm run build
+      - run: node scripts/build-rework-harness.mjs
+      - name: Render the actual installed art and gather room evidence
+        run: npx playwright test --config=playwright.art-production.config.ts --grep '${{ matrix.group }}' --reporter=line --output=test-results/production-art
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: cinder-art-${{ matrix.group }}
+          path: |
+            test-results/production-art/
+            dist/cinder-shift/build-manifest.json

+# Cinder Shift production art
+
+Original generated masters, transparent-object crop maps, reproducible exports and editable SVG materials/hand layers. The untouched PNG masters and prompts are in `source/`. `manifest.json` records every source hash, exported frame, visible bounds and source rectangle.
+
+Run `npm run art:production`, then `npm run art:check`. Export uses hard alpha, nearest-neighbour sampling and a shared 256-colour palette. Background textures are 320×140, displayed at 640×280 with nearest-neighbour filtering and loaded by sector. Original master pixels remain available for re-export.
+
+The atlas contains 176 frames: 60 sector props, 60 mechanism states, 30 world-enemy states, 15 base-enemy states, 5 Regulator aperture states and 6 carry/action overlays. The runtime also uses 16 sector backgrounds and 10 material kits. Actual object positions come from gameplay geometry. The renderer never advances gameplay state.
+
+`previews/contact-sheet.png` shows the actual exported frames. It is an asset preview, not a screenshot of the game. `playwright.art-production.config.ts` and the art-production workflow collect actual Phaser evidence in every room. Physical mobile/device validation and complete production acceptance remain open; see the alpha.15 report.
+
+Original exports are retained as `reference-atlas.png` and `reference-manifest.json`. Runtime PNG/JSON, material SVG exports and the contact sheet are rebuilt automatically by npm check, build, dev, test and art checks. Derived runtime assets and previews are ignored by Git; source masters and SVGs remain versioned. The change to automatic export was prepared after the local environment disconnected and must pass CI on its own commit.

@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+{
+  "baseBackgrounds": "Production pixel-art BACKGROUND SHEET for the FIRST campaign of CINDER SHIFT 64 industrial side-view platform game. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS x THREE ROWS of panoramic rectangular scenes. No text, labels, UI, hero, enemies, floating platforms, foreground gameplay objects. Detailed 16-bit pixel art with clear square clusters, dark ink outlines, cold navy steel #142331/#20384a/#405c70, brass #dfa568, cream highlights #efd6a4, teal #65a7a5; coherent civilian orbital industrial complex, worn practical machinery, depth and atmospheric light. Each panel has three readable depth planes and a DARK QUIET LOWER THIRD, clean uninterrupted space for engine-added colliders. EXACT order: row1 left AIRLOCK: pressure bulkheads, dock windows, huge ventilation fans, pressure gauges, curved metal ducts, cyan cool lighting; row1 right CARGO: rail gantry, stacked shipping containers, freight elevator structure, crane hoists, orange work lights and distant loading dock; row2 left FOUNDRY: large furnaces, casting vats, suspended hydraulic assemblies and cooling pipes, warm rust-orange glow; row2 right ARCHIVE: tall server cabinets and tape spools, shelves, analog consoles, optical conduits, muted violet-cyan lighting, distinct library-of-machines feel; row3 left REACTOR: huge shielded circular reactor in distance, cooling turbines, power bus conduits, restrained mint light, very detailed but quiet lower combat lane; row3 right REGULATOR CHAMBER: colossal maintenance hall with overhead gantries, cable harnesses, deep steel buttresses, round reactor window behind boss staging zone on RIGHT, empty foreground, amber warning fixture architecture, no boss drawn. Make all panels distinct, finished commercial game environment illustration. Panel borders exactly aligned in even grid, edge-to-edge imagery, no gutters.",
+  "baseEnemies": "CINDER SHIFT 64 industrial pixel-art GAME SPRITES. Transparent background with alpha zero outside each object. Landscape 1536x1024. EXACT GRID 5 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, 20 isolated sprites centered in cells, generous empty margins. No text, labels, grid lines, floor shadows or backgrounds. Hard pixel clusters at 80 logical pixels per sprite, nearest-neighbor feel, detailed commercial-quality metal shading. Palette navy #142331, blue steel #405c70, cool edge #78949f, cream #efd6a4, yellow hazard brass #dfa568, turquoise #65a7a5 and vulnerable core #91d2b8. Facing LEFT, side-view platform game, NOT isometric. Five states per row: idle / warning / attack / exposed recovery / destroyed. Row1 MAINTENANCE WALKER: two short articulated legs, compact riveted steel body, cream shoulder shell, horizontal plasma tool gun, amber three-slot sensor, different purposeful silhouettes in each state. Row2 SECURITY DRONE: compact flying armored steel sphere with two short ducted thrusters, horizontal camera slit, copper coils, left-facing emitter, warning antenna extends, firing muzzle, vent flaps open to show mint capacitor core, broken wreck. Row3 RAM CHARGER: low heavy wheeled maintenance bulldozer with a shield-plough front, steel and yellow caution strips, idle upright shield, warning crouched charge preparation, attack shield-forward charge, recovery shield lifted and mint engine open, wreck. Row4 REGULATOR CHEST APERTURE INSERT ONLY: a small horizontal octagonal armored opening, dark blue steel rim with four brass corner bolts, designed to be composited into an existing giant robot's chest. Five equal-footprint states: closed ribbed metal shutters; closed shutters with amber warning vents; locked armored shutters with copper charge lines; fully parted shutters exposing a detailed glowing mint cylindrical reactor with copper coils and cables; dark shattered powerless reactor. Aperture insert must be a finished mechanical component, not a simple rectangle or UI icon. Row4 all exactly same horizontal frame shape and size, substantial inset depth and metal bevels, narrow side wings for opened shutters. Every sprite isolated and consistent within row, no people."
+}
